text:
aaron: PR 512 ready - added migration note about routing defaults and an example config showing equal-weight behavior. Holding for runtime confirm before merge: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/512

mira: looks mostly good. one blocker: you used 'stable-hash' in code sample. runtime needs the exact key name and which headers are hashed. cc runtime folks.

samira: runtime confirmation: canonical config value is `routing.selection_strategy = "hash_with_rr_fallback"`. hashing order: `Idempotency-Key`, then `X-Request-ID`. if neither header exists we fallback to a per-worker round-robin (not globally deterministic).

aaron: thanks. i'll update the sample to the exact string and add a note about non-global determinism. do we also call out `routing.pin_model_version`?

samira: yes — if `routing.pin_model_version = true` and client supplies a variant id, runtime bypasses selection and routes directly. include a tiny example showing how to pin.

devops-bot: Preview failed: linkcheck error on internal anchor /internal/runtime/routing.md#tie-breaker (404).

mira: ok remove the internal anchor and link to a public runtime docs anchor. @samira can you open a small runtime docs PR to add a public anchor?

samira: will do, creating runtime docs PR now and will ping when merged. ETA ~20m. marking docs PR as hold until runtime anchor exists and preview passes.

aaron: will re-run preview after runtime PR merges, merge-on-green off. thanks everyone. :lock:
